principles.item: Do not skip grounding/escalation for demo speed.
Default CI and local: USE_STUBS=true; live suites gated by RUN_LIVE_*.
Keep REST contracts stable after phase 1; version if breaking.
Russian user-facing copy OK; identifiers English.
All product work under server/ (rules, context, app, tests).
LangGraph for dialogue graph; do not adopt LangChain RetrievalQA as primary RAG.

goals.goal: Create server/ package layout (api, application, domain, adapters, stubs, config).
Wire FastAPI app with OpenAPI for all minimum endpoints (may return stub payloads).
Settings from env; .env.example consumed by pydantic-settings.
Global USE_STUBS + per-adapter factories returning Stub* implementations.
Declare langgraph (+ optional langchain-core) in pyproject; placeholder dialogue graph module.

deliverables.item: server/pyproject.toml, app entrypoint, health check
Router stubs for appeals/messages/officer-reply/stats
Empty/stub adapter protocols + StubLLM, StubEmbeddings, StubVectorStore, StubDocling, StubEscalation
Contract OpenAPI snapshot or schema tests
Skeleton StateGraph file under application/dialogue/

acceptance.check: uvicorn boots with USE_STUBS=true; no outbound AI calls
All documented REST paths exist and validate request/response models
Factories selectable by env without code changes
langgraph importable; graph compiles with stub no-op nodes

goals.goal: PostgreSQL as system of record via SQLAlchemy 2 async + asyncpg.
StubPersistence for unit tests; PERSISTENCE_USE_STUB / DATABASE_URL from env.
Implement list/get/create appeal; append and list messages; history survives restart.
Appeal status transitions + audit events durable in Postgres.
Stats aggregates readable from DB (even if thin).

deliverables.item: Domain models + Persistence port + StubPersistence + SqlAlchemyPersistence
Alembic migrations for appeals, messages, escalations, audit_events
Working appeal/message API against Postgres
CLIENT_INFO.md kept in sync with response shapes

acceptance.check: Create appeal → post message → restart app → GET messages returns same history
GET /appeals filters by status
Audit trail rows present for mutations
Unit tests pass with StubPersistence; optional RUN_LIVE_POSTGRES integration

goals.goal: Implement LangGraph dialogue: clarify / grounded answer / escalate using stub retrieval.
Grounding policy: no answer without stub citations matching fixture regulations.
Escalation creates ticket + StubEscalation notify + user-facing Russian notice.
Underspecified questions produce clarifying assistant messages.

deliverables.item: StateGraph nodes wired to grounding + quality_escalation + stub ports
Fixture KB in stubs for demo Q&A
Behavior tests for clarify/answer/escalate (stubs; no live calls)

acceptance.check: Known fixture question → answer with citations
Ambiguous question → clarification, status clarifying
Unknown topic → escalate, no invented regulation text
Success criteria 1 and 2 demonstrable with stubs
Graph path auditable (node outcomes logged or asserted)

goals.goal: Implement HttpLLM, HttpEmbeddings, QdrantVectorStore, HttpDocling, LibreOffice adapter.
Enable via *_USE_STUB=false without changing application services or graph topology.
Timeouts, batch sizes, and error mapping from env.
Add tests/integration/ with RUN_LIVE_* skips when secrets/infra absent.

deliverables.item: Real adapters using httpx / qdrant-client
Live smoke tests per adapter (markers integration; gated)
SSRF allowlist for base URLs (security_rules)
Document how to run live tests in README / testing_rules

acceptance.check: CI still green with stubs only (RUN_LIVE_*=0)
With secrets present, flipping flags + RUN_LIVE_* reaches real services
Failures surface as typed errors; no secret leakage in logs

goals.goal: Ingest pipeline from local corpus ($DOCS_CORPUS_PATH / $DOCS_DIR, default server/docs/*.docx, gitignored) through Docling/LibreOffice → chunk → embed → Qdrant.
Blue/green collections and QDRANT_COLLECTION alias.
Document/chunk metadata in persistence.

deliverables.item: ingest CLI or admin endpoint (prototype-simple)
HybridChunker params from DOCLING_* env
Idempotent re-ingest by checksum where feasible

acceptance.check: Sample docx appears as searchable chunks (stub or real per flags)
Alias points to active collection after swap
Retrieval prefer-latest respects document version/effective_date when set

goals.goal: POST officer-reply stores canonical answer, resolves escalation, triggers KB update.
Subsequent similar questions can be answered from updated KB (stub or real).
Log all learning events.
Stub e2e + optional RUN_LIVE_E2E learning scenario.

deliverables.item: learning service wired to ingest
Tests: escalate → officer-reply → answer on replay (stubs always; live optional)

acceptance.check: Success criterion 3 demonstrable end-to-end with stubs
Appeal status resolved_by_officer / closed as designed
Audit contains officer + ingest linkage
Live e2e learning test skips cleanly without RUN_LIVE_E2E

goals.goal: GET /stats: counts by status, clarify rate, escalation rate, answered rate, learning updates.
JSON structured logs; request_id middleware; LOG_* redaction.
Optional CACHE_* for embeddings/responses with invalidation on ingest.

deliverables.item: Stats service
Logging middleware polish
Ops notes in README or project_context update if needed

acceptance.check: Stats match DB after scripted scenario
Logs include correlation fields without secrets/PII overload

goals.goal: Scripted scenarios covering all three success criteria.
Seed fixtures + demo script (curl or pytest marker demo).
Document demo path for stakeholders (Russian narrative OK).
Document live RUN_LIVE_E2E path for the same scenarios when infra is up.

deliverables.item: scenarios: grounded answer; clarify then answer; escalate + officer learn
Short DEMO.md under server/

acceptance.check: All three criteria runnable offline with stubs
Optional live path documented but not required for the core prototype demo
